rationale: The approved durable UR and bounded impact support a scoped structured path, but the change affects product semantics across three canonical owners and three source paths. Compact Delivery is unavailable because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not supplied; Verified Change is ineligible because ownership is not singular and propagation is not deterministic.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Three canonical owners and three source paths are involved.
Baseline is clean and validation is deterministic.
No runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API, CLI contract, release, or cross-host impact is23.
Completed Brownfield analysis is not evidenced.
Stored quick_task context is not evidenced.
Any broader impact requires fail-closed escalation.
